title: Karu
overview: A selfish man, unable to father a child due to his own infertility, devises a disturbing plan — to convince his sister to conceive his child through surrogate motherhood. As his obsession with legacy and control deepens, he crosses moral boundaries, manipulating those closest to him in his desperate pursuit of bloodline and identity.
